"War" is a song by American rap/hip-hop musician Caleb Gordon.  It was released on , through Eden Records and Irish Town Songs.  The song charted at No. 24 on the Billboard Hot Christian Songs chart, becoming Gordon's first chart entry.
Background
The song includes an introductory sample of the Bob Marley song of the same name, causing the song to be removed in October 2024 due to copyright issues.  It was restored a week later.
Upon release, the song was supported with the War Tour.  On , it was performed at Universal's Rock the Universe concert.
Commercial performance
"War" debuted at No. 36 on the Billboard Hot Christian Songs on , and later charted at No. 24 on the chart.  The song remained on the chart for sixteen weeks following that.
